description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Bundles the pack's finished scenes into a flat ZIP (WebMs + PNGs + manifest.json) uploaded to R2, returning a time-limited signed download URL. This is the flat agent pack, not the full themed folder-tree artifact (scenes/stinger/alerts/sheet-tile ladders with composited branding) -- that comes from the 'Download pack' button in the web editor at this result's editorUrl.
name: export_pack_zip
title: Export a pack ZIP
